findingDetails.title: Default dated folders can overwrite same-day evidence
findingDetails.evidence: The default path has no unique suffix or occupancy check before recursive directory creation and direct report writes.
findingDetails.claim: The default path can overwrite an earlier same-day run with the same subject and variant.
findingDetails.recommendation: Allocate a unique suffix or fail closed before writes.
findingDetails.scopeProof: runFolderName() emits three fields only; the owning storage authority requires a same-day trailing disambiguator.

results.summary: Same-day disambiguation is specified but absent from the default writer.
